fields.name: light volume
fields.definition: Draws a sequence of glow bitmaps along a line. Can be used for contrail-type effects as well as volumetric lights.

fields.name: attachment marker#the marker name that the light volume should be attached to
brightness scale
fields.definition: Fades the effect in and out with distance, viewer angle, and external source.

fields.name: near fade distance:world units#distance at which light volume is full brightness
far fade distance:world units#distance at which light volume is zero brightness
perpendicular brightness scale:[0,1]#brightness scale when viewed at a 90-degree angle
parallel brightness scale:[0,1]#brightness scale when viewed directly
brightness scale source#scales brightness based on external value
bitmaps
fields.definition: Bitmap tag used to draw the light volume, repeated <count> times. Default is 'tags\rasterizer_textures\glow'. Note that sprite plates are not valid for light volumes.

fields.name: count#number of bitmaps to draw (0 causes light volume not to render)
frame animation
fields.definition: Frames are descriptions of the light volume at a particular point in time, interpolated by an external source. For example, a bolt of energy can be made to stretch out and grow thinner as it is fired from a weapon.

fields.name: frame animation source#interpolates between frames based on external value
offset exponent#0 defaults to 1; >1 compresses light near marker, <1 compresses light near far end
length:world units#0 causes light volume not to render
radius hither:world units#radius near the marker
radius yon:world units#radius at far end of light volume
radius exponent#0 defaults to 1; >1 values are more teardrop-shaped, <1 values are more pill-shaped
tint color hither#tint color near the marker (alpha is brightness)
tint color yon#tint color at far end of light volume (alpha is brightness)
tint color exponent#0 defaults to 1; affects tint color only, not brightness
